en: A black‑and‑white view of an elegant 19th‑century urban park with a circular flowerbed in the foreground and a tree‑lined promenade and street beyond. On the right stands a richly ornamented neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance mansion with pinnacles, gables and statues in niches; to the left are more bourgeois townhouses. Several blurred figures, likely pedestrians or cyclists, move along the street, suggesting a long exposure typical of early photography. The scene conveys a refined European city environment.
